subject: Request: subprocessor affiliations, egress jurisdictions, and proposed cutover timeline
messages:
From: Sophie Miller <sophie.miller@bluewave.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 18 Apr 2025 09:23:00 -0700
Subject: New CDN subprocessor — request for roster details and cutover window

Hi Tessa,

We're preparing to onboard EdgeMesh (their ops team in CC) as a CDN/edge-logging provider for a pilot of our payments telemetry. Before we move forward, our security team asked for a few concrete items so we can complete our internal vendor assessment:

- Full subprocessor roster that will touch logs from the pilot (names + corporate entities).
- Countries where EdgeMesh will store or transit logs (including any third-party replication).
- Whether EdgeMesh will require temporary cross-account S3 or database access during cutover.
- Proposed cutover window and rollback plan (we'd prefer a two-week notice).
- Confirmation of encryption-in-transit and at-rest and KMS usage, plus SOC2 or ISO attestations.

Can you share the roster and a target cutover timeline? Also note if an amendment to the DPA will be required.

Thanks — Sophie
Sophie Miller
Senior Security Program Manager, BlueWave Payments
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
To: Sophie Miller <sophie.miller@bluewave.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 18 Apr 2025 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: New CDN subprocessor — request for roster details and cutover window

Hi Sophie — thanks for the clear list. I'm looping in Kimberly (legal) and Marissa (privacy/partnerships) to get the definitive answers and the current subprocessor inventory.

Quick answers while we pull the files:
- We'll provide our current subprocessor roster extract and a draft cutover plan (attached).
- EdgeMesh is currently listed as a provisional partner for edge caching in our staging roster; technical details and jurisdictions need confirmation.
- If EdgeMesh will have persistent log access or cross-account read access, we will require a short DPA amendment (Kimberly can confirm).

We'll aim to get you a consolidated package by Monday EOD (and a Drive link). If BlueWave needs an earlier window, flag it and we'll prioritize.

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Head of Partnerships — Redwood Inference
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 18 Apr 2025 11:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: New CDN subprocessor — request for roster details and cutover window

Thanks for the heads-up. A few legal/compliance notes:

- DPA implication: any vendor with access to logs containing customer-identifiable metadata requires a DPA addendum. We should prepare our standard DPA amendment (attached) and track signature before granting production access.
- Notification period: our standard is 30 days for subprocessor additions; we can contractually accelerate to 14 days for pilots if both parties agree and the vendor provides attestations.
- Evidence: request SOC 2 Type II and a network diagram showing replication paths. If EdgeMesh replicates outside of declared jurisdictions, we need export controls checked.
- Contracts: propose we include an explicit limitation on retention for pilot logs (30 days by default).

I'll draft the amendment and share redlines. Jonas, can you confirm the access pattern required for cutover?

-Kim
Kimberly Park
Senior Counsel, Privacy & Security
Redwood Inference
From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 19 Apr 2025 08:17:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: New CDN subprocessor — request for roster details and cutover window

Technical notes from infra:

- EdgeMesh will be used for caching + optional request-logging; logs in pilot will be sampled telemetry only, not full request bodies.
- Proposed storage/egress: primary storage in us-east(US) and eu-west(EU); replication to APAC not planned.
- Cutover access: EdgeMesh will request temporary read-only S3 access to a staging bucket and IAM role exchange for log ingestion during the 48-hour cutover window. No DB write permissions required.
- Encryption: EdgeMesh supports TLS 1.3 and will use customer-managed KMS keys if we configure them. We need to confirm KMS key custody options.
- Timeline: infra can support a cutover weekend: May 9–10, 2025, with rollback slot on May 11. If BlueWave wants two weeks notice, that fits — we can schedule the pilot for late May.

I'll attach a short technical cutover plan for Sophie.

-Jonas
Jonas Weber
Director, Platform Infrastructure
Redwood Inference
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
To: Sophie Miller <sophie.miller@bluewave.com>, EdgeMesh Ops <onboarding@edgemesh.io>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 20 Apr 2025 16:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: New CDN subprocessor — request for roster details and cutover window

Hi Sophie — thanks for the patience. Attached is the current subprocessor roster extract (bluewave_subprocessor_roster_v1.xlsx) and our draft cutover plan (edgemesh_cutover_plan_draft.pdf). Highlights:

- EdgeMesh (Edgemesh, Inc.) is listed as provisional for edge caching/staging only — we currently route staging traffic and maintain a limited telemetry access profile.
- Jurisdictions: primary storage/transit for the pilot: US (us-east), EU (eu-west). No APAC replication planned.
- Access pattern: temporary read-only S3 staging access via a short-lived IAM role exchange for the 48-hour cutover window; no DB writes.
- Compliance: EdgeMesh has a SOC2 report; we will request the Type II attestation before production.
- DPA amendment: Kimberly has prepared an addendum template (dpa_amendment_template.docx). For the pilot, we propose a 14-day notification/agreement cycle; for production we will revert to the standard 30-day notice.

Next steps we suggest:
1) BlueWave review the attached roster and the cutover draft and confirm the jurisdictions are acceptable.
2) BlueWave sign the DPA addendum for pilot access (we can host a DocuSign link once you confirm).
3) Schedule the cutover weekend — proposed target: May 9–10, rollback May 11.

Drive link to the package: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2B3cR-subprocessor-roster

If you need any additional evidence (network diagrams, KMS key custody options, or the SOC2 letter), Kimberly and Jonas can provide them.

Thanks,
Tessa Morgan
Head of Partnerships — Redwood Inference
